FIELDS.NAME: Vacuum Masters Sales & Service
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vacuum Masters Sales & Service specializes in the retail sale of new and refurbished vacuum cleaners, along with effective repair and maintenance services for residential and light commercial models. Our operations are rooted in creating a customer-centric experience, which includes offering a wide range of accessories and replacement parts sourced from reputable manufacturers. We adhere to strict safety and quality standards, ensuring all staff members receive documented training for electrical repairs and that onsite service activities are supervised by qualified personnel to minimize risks. With a commitment to sustainable practices, we also facilitate the recycling of old vacuum cleaners through controlled processes. Our retail storefront, coupled with robust inventory management systems and a strong online presence, positions us effectively in the market while maintaining compliance with all local safety regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: CleanSweep Services LLC - a coordinated service offering for carpet and upholstery cleaning in accordance with specific underwriting guidelines.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a customer reported a minor incident involving a vacuum cleaner malfunction. The cause was identified as a temporary electrical issue during a repair in our service center. The estimated loss amount was $200 for the replacement of a damaged part. The incident has been resolved with no follow-up claims, and our repair protocols have been updated to prevent recurrence.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sun Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, Fire Rated Vault with UL certification for secure storage of cash and important documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and supervised monitoring during business hours.
